assistant.title: News Assistant
assistant.needAi: Connect AI to ask about any news, or about what's in your subscriptions.
assistant.welcomeBody: Ask about any news story, or about what's in your subscriptions. Answers carry numbered sources you can open.

suggest.today: What are today's most important stories?
suggest.library: What's new in tech across my subscriptions?
suggest.explain: Why have oil prices been moving lately?

assistant.webOn: Online: search news and the web
assistant.webNewsOnly: Online: search news (this AI service can't search the web)
assistant.unsourced: Unnumbered lines come from the model's own knowledge and are not checked against a source.

errors.chat_busy: The previous question is still being answered.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the AI service. Check your network.
errors.unreachable: Couldn't reach the AI service. Check your network.
errors.rate_limited: The AI service is rate limiting. Try again later.
errors.quota_exhausted: The AI service is out of quota.
errors.context_exceeded: The material is larger than the model's context limit.
errors.unsupported: The current model doesn't support this.

today.noAiBody: Connect AI to get a daily brief written around your watches. Until then, the list shows the last 24 hours of headlines from each source.
today.noWatchesBody: The brief is written around what you follow. Add a watch to start.
today.noDigestBody: With background updates on, it is written every morning. You can also write it now.
today.openWatch: Show this story’s progress in Watches

flashes.needAiBody: Flashes pick the latest developments from your watches, one or two sentences each.
flashes.empty: Nothing worth interrupting you for in this period.
flashes.emptyFiltered: No important flashes. Turn off the filter to see all.
flashes.snippetOnlyHint: The article could not be fetched; this was written from the source’s summary.
flashes.searchFilledHint: The article could not be fetched; details were verified and filled in by search.

background.title: Background Updates
background.question: Turn on background updates?
background.body: With the window closed, 所闻 still writes today's brief at 7:15 every morning and checks flashes every 3 hours. It pauses while the Mac sleeps and catches up on waking.
background.where: Turn it off any time in Settings → Background, or in System Settings → General → Login Items.
background.failed: Couldn't turn it on. Try again later in Settings → Background.

settings.title: Settings
settings.uiLanguageHint: The language AI writes in is set under AI.
settings.readingLanguagesHint: Show only articles in the selected languages. Articles whose language couldn't be detected are always shown.
settings.aiIntro: Reading needs no AI. Connecting one enables the daily brief, flashes, progress and the news assistant. Keys stay on this Mac; with a cloud service, the articles involved are sent to it.

keyHint.gemini: Create one in Google AI Studio. Billed by Google.
keyHint.openai: Create one in the OpenAI Platform. Billed by OpenAI.
keyHint.anthropic: Create one in the Anthropic Console. Billed by Anthropic.
keyHint.compatible: Leave empty if the service needs no key.

settings.embedHint: Finds related articles by meaning; leave empty to match by keywords only.
settings.ollamaHint: Install and start Ollama on this Mac first. Local models can't search the web.
settings.outputLanguageHint: Used for briefs, flashes and assistant answers.
settings.searchFillHint: When an important flash's article can't be fetched, verify and complete it with the AI service's search.
settings.outsidePicksHint: Each daily update picks a few important events outside what you follow.

connection.no_key: Saved, but the API key is missing
connection.network: Couldn't connect. Check the network and endpoint
connection.unreachable: Couldn't connect. Check the network and endpoint
connection.rate_limited: The service is rate limiting. Try again later
connection.quota_exhausted: The account is out of credit or quota
connection.context_exceeded: The context limit is too small
connection.unsupported: This endpoint doesn't support what's needed
connection.model_missing: A required model is missing. Download it or check the name
connection.ollama_down: Couldn't reach Ollama. Make sure it's running

settings.rsshubIntro: Subscribe to social platforms such as Weibo, Bilibili and more. The extension downloads on demand (about 63 MB, 370 MB installed).
settings.instanceHint: When set, this server is used instead of the local extension. Only use one you trust.
settings.xIntro: X is fetched through Apify, about $0.02 per X source per update, billed by Apify. The token stays on this Mac.
settings.backgroundIntro: Keep updating with the window closed. Pauses while the Mac sleeps and catches up on waking.
settings.loginItems: Appears in System Settings → General → Login Items.
settings.noLanguages: Article languages appear here once subscriptions update.

auto.label: Detect
auto.hint: Paste a web address, feed address or channel name; the type is detected.

rss.label: RSS / Atom
rss.hint: Any RSS or Atom feed address.

telegram.label: Telegram
telegram.hint: Public channels, no sign-in. Channels with web preview turned off can't be followed.

github.label: GitHub
github.hint: User activity, repository releases (owner/repo), or trending (optionally with a language, e.g. trending:rust).

apify_x.label: X / Twitter
apify_x.hint: Needs an Apify token in Settings → More Sources; billed per run.

rsshub.label: RSSHub Route
rsshub.hint: Enter a route by hand. Common platforms are ready under Social Platforms.

rsshub.packBanner: Social platforms come through RSSHub, which needs a one-time download (about 63 MB).
rsshub.pastePlaceholder: Paste a page address, e.g. a Sspai author or a Jike circle
rsshub.notRecognised: That address wasn't recognised. Pick a platform below instead.
rsshub.pasteHint: You can also paste the page's address above, e.g. {{example}}

watches.empty: Describe something you want to follow in a sentence, or pick from the topic library.
watches.noAi: No AI connected: articles are matched by keywords, without relevance judgement or progress.
watches.pickHint: See related coverage and progress, or change its settings.
watches.libraryHint: Pick several at once. Each can be reworded afterwards.
watches.intentPlaceholder: e.g. How Apple is reshaping its supply chain in China, including factories moving out and related policy
watches.intentHint: Be specific: who, what, and which side of it you care about. AI judges each article against this sentence.
watches.intentJudge: AI judges relevance against this sentence, word for word.
watches.name: Name
watches.keywordsHint: Comma-separated. Without AI, articles are matched by these; with AI they only widen the candidates.
watches.busy: Another task is running. Try again shortly
watches.noItems: No related coverage yet. Click Update Now to start filtering.
watches.noItemsKeywords: Without AI, add keywords under Settings first.
watches.verdictHint: Mark whether a story is relevant, with an optional reason, to improve future filtering.
watches.keywordMatchHint: Matched by keyword, not judged by AI
watches.scoreHint: Relevance AI gave against your description
watches.whyNot: Reason (optional), e.g. only mentioned in passing
watches.timelineNeedsAi: Progress is traced by AI and appears once AI is connected.
watches.openQuestionsHint: Loose ends from earlier updates; looked for first next time.
watches.noMilestones: No progress yet. It appears here after an update.
watches.aidsHint: Only widen the candidates; relevance is still judged against your description.
watches.savedIntentChanged: Saved. The next update judges against the new description.
watches.activeHint: When off, the watch stops updating and keeps what it has.
watches.updateHint: Fetch the latest coverage, filter it again and update the progress

report.title: Deep Report
report.gathering: Gathering related coverage and reading it in full…
report.askPlaceholder: Ask a follow-up about this story
report.researchHint: Search for more related coverage before answering

errors.conversation_busy: The previous follow-up is still being written.
errors.uncited_report: The model gave nothing it could cite. Try again.
errors.empty_report: The model returned nothing. Try again.
